instructions: Press tofu 10 minutes, cube, and sear in oil until golden on all sides; set aside.
Stir-fry broccoli and bell pepper 3-4 minutes; add garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return tofu, add tamari, and toss to coat.
Serve with Organic electrolyte drink (355 g).
